verdict.rationale: Hatchet documents official SDKs for Python, TypeScript, Go and Ruby, and a community thread confirms SDKs exist beyond Python, so authoring workflows in the team's language is supported. The evidence never shows real feature parity across those SDKs, and a community comment notes the docs lean heavily toward Python. missing for 10: documented cross-SDK feature-parity matrix, evidence that advanced features (concurrency, cron, rate limits) work equally in TS/Go/Ruby, independent hands-on corroboration of non-Python SDK maturity.

support.subject: As a backend developer, I author workflows in the language my team already uses — TypeScript, Python, Go, or more — with real feature parity across SDKs
